payload.reason: The evidence describes specific experiments conducted to investigate the effects of layer normalization in Transformer architectures and the implications for training configurations.

claims.text: They conduct experiments on the Pre-Layer Normalization Transformer to analyze gradient behavior and the removal of the learning rate warm-up stage.
Experiments include IWSLT14 German-English translation, WMT14 English-German translation, and BERT pre-training tasks.
They repeat experiments ten times using different random seeds to ensure consistency with theoretical insights.
